integrity_notes: Analytic projection proof supplies the universal statement; exact-rational finite checks are corroborative and not substitutes for proof. The closest later dissertation was checked for overlap; unindexed equivalent reformulations remain possible.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to zero-dipole spin-one mixed states only and optimizes over the spin-coherent (symmetric two-qubit separable) hull, not the unrestricted two-qubit separable set. Coherent-state decompositions of the unique nearest state may be nonunique.
title: Exact quantumness–negativity identity for zero-dipole spin-one states
